mechanism: Piperacillin-tazobactam may reduce oxycodone metabolism through weak CYP3A4 inhibition, potentially increasing oxycodone levels; additionally, severe infection/sepsis treated with this antibiotic can alter oxycodone pharmacokinetics and increase CNS depression risk.
action: Monitor for signs of opioid toxicity (excessive sedation, respiratory depression); consider oxycodone dose reduction if needed and ensure adequate pain control assessment during concurrent use.
